summary: Study Habits session for 10th standard students of Shri J P High School, Kharodi, Malad West was conducted from 12th Oct to 15th Oct.
description:
Study Habits session for 10th standard students of Shri J P High School, Kharodi, Malad West was conducted from 12th Oct to 15th Oct. The session was conducted by PP Rtn Sunita Hirlekar. We are thankful to Sunita ji for conducting the session which will make a huge difference in grades of these students at such an important milestone.

We also thank Rtn. Vikas Hirlekar for motivating the children with his presence and special thanks to our Education Director, Rtn. Parag Storewala, for his unwavering commitment and efforts in making this initiative a success
